list_comfyui_workflows.description: List the workflow JSON files saved in ComfyUI's own workflow folder, with each file's format (api, ui or invalid) and size.

read_comfyui_workflow.description: Read one saved ComfyUI workflow and report its nodes and its prompt text. Reports format 'ui' or 'api'; a UI-format file is readable but not runnable.

name.description: Workflow file name, inside ComfyUI's workflow folder.

path.description: Absolute path inside ComfyUI's workflow folder instead of name.

run_comfyui_workflow.description: Submit an API-format ComfyUI graph to /prompt and return its prompt_id. Refuses a UI-format workflow instead of sending something ComfyUI would reject.

name.description: Name of a saved API-format workflow file.

path.description: Absolute path of a saved API-format workflow file.

get_comfyui_queue.description: Report ComfyUI's queue: what is running and what is waiting, with prompt ids and counts.

get_comfyui_history.description: Report finished ComfyUI jobs and the output image references they produced (filename, subfolder, type).

prompt_id.description: One job id; omit for the recent list.

list_comfyui_models.description: List the model files ComfyUI has on disk: checkpoints, LoRAs, VAEs and embeddings, with sizes.

list_comfyui_nodes.description: List available ComfyUI node types and their categories, or fetch one node's full input schema when a class_type is given.

class_type.description: One node type, to return its full input schema.

category.description: Filter the list to one category.

save_comfyui_workflow.description: Write a workflow JSON into ComfyUI's workflow folder. Refuses to overwrite an existing file unless overwrite is true.

name.description: File name to write, inside ComfyUI's workflow folder.

path.description: Absolute path inside ComfyUI's workflow folder instead of name.

edit_comfyui_workflow.description: Change an API-format workflow in place: swap the checkpoint or a LoRA, rewrite prompt text, set a seed, or change the output filename prefix. Any other change key is refused.

changes.description: Only these keys are accepted: checkpoint, lora, prompts, seed, filename_prefix.

checkpoint.description: New checkpoint filename for the first CheckpointLoaderSimple.

upload_comfyui_image.description: Push an image into ComfyUI's input folder, either from a local file path or from base64 data.

data_base64.description: Image bytes as base64 (alt to path).

filename.description: Name to store it under (defaults to the file name).

get_comfyui_output_image.description: Fetch a generated image from ComfyUI by filename and save it locally, returning the saved path and size.

cancel_comfyui_job.description: Interrupt ComfyUI's running job, or remove a queued one. With queue_only and no prompt_id, clears the pending queue.

queue_only.description: Clear pending jobs rather than interrupt the running one.

trim_video.description: Cut a section out of a video with ffmpeg and write it to a new file. Give either duration_seconds or end_seconds.

path.description: Source video (must exist, under an allowed root).

output_path.description: Where to write the trimmed video.

end_seconds.description: End offset, if no duration is given.

concat_video.description: Join two or more video files into one, in the order given, using ffmpeg's concat demuxer.

output_path.description: Where to write the joined video.

search_music_catalog.description: Search the Fortress song catalog (43 song files) by title or lyric text and return matching songs with a snippet.

query.description: Text to look for; empty returns the first N songs.

create_pdf.description: Create a PDF from a title and paragraphs, by building a document and converting it with LibreOffice.

items.description: A string, or {text, style:'heading', level}, or {bullets:[...]}

create_docx.description: Create a Word document from a title, paragraphs (strings or {heading, level} or {bullets}), and optional tables.

items.description: A string, or {text, style:'heading', level}, or {bullets:[...]}

create_spreadsheet.description: Create an .xlsx workbook from one or more sheets, each a name and a list of rows.

create_presentation.description: Create a .pptx deck from a list of slides, each with a title and bullet lines.

deploy_website.description: Publish a site with vercel (production by default) or wrangler, in the given directory, and return the deployed URL. Requires Chrissy's approval.

git_checkout.description: Switch a repository to an existing branch. Requires Chrissy's approval; refused without a kernel execution grant.

cwd.description: Repository directory (must contain .git and sit under an allowed root).

git_branch.description: Create a branch and switch to it, optionally from a starting ref. Requires Chrissy's approval.

git_merge.description: Merge one branch into the current one with --no-edit. Requires Chrissy's approval.

git_push.description: Push the current branch to a remote. Never forces. Requires Chrissy's approval.

git_pull.description: Fast-forward-only pull from a remote, so it can never create a surprise merge. Requires Chrissy's approval.

query_local_database.description: Run one read-only SELECT/WITH query against an allowlisted local sqlite database and return columns and rows. Refuses anything that could write, including PRAGMA and ATTACH.

database.description: One of the three allowlisted FortressTerminal sqlite files.

sql.description: A single SELECT or WITH statement.
